mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_task (task_no, initiator_id, status) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{initiatorId}, #{status})

INSERT INTO inventory_item (task_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, actual_version_id, actual_status, difference_type, difference_description, checked_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{expectedVersionId}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{actualVersionId}, #{actualStatus}, #{differenceType}, #{differenceDescription}, #{checkedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, status, initiator_id FROM inventory_task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id, i.task_id, i.archive_version_id AS expected_version_id, av.version_no AS expected_version_no, i.actual_version_id, i.employee_id, i.department_id, i.actual_status, i.difference_type, i.difference_description, i.checked_by, i.resolution_status, e.resolution, emp.employee_no AS employee_no, emp.name AS employee_name, d.title AS document_title FROM inventory_item i JOIN archive_version av ON av.id = i.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = av.document_id JOIN employee emp ON emp.id = i.employee_id LEFT JOIN exception_record e ON e.id = ( SELECT MAX(e2.id) FROM exception_record e2 WHERE e2.inventory_item_id = i.id ) WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET actual_version_id = #{actualVersionId}, actual_status = #{actualStatus}, difference_type = #{differenceType}, difference_description = #{differenceDescription}, checked_by = #{checkedBy}, checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, resolution_status = #{resolutionStatus} WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND resolution_status = 'PENDING' AND actual_status IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exception_record (inventory_item_id, exception_type, description, status) VALUES (#{inventoryItemId}, #{exceptionType}, #{description}, 'OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET resolution_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND resolution_status = 'OPEN'
